facts.business: Lexus Granito (India) Limited is engaged in the manufacturing and sale of ceramic tiles.
key_risks: Volatility in prices and availability of key raw materials, fuel and energy costs
Intense competition, pricing pressures and changes in demand from real estate and construction sectors
Changes in international trade policies, tariffs and regulatory requirements in export markets
Continuous evolution of product designs, formats, finishes and manufacturing technologies requiring ongoing focus on product innovation and operational efficiency
